main_text.p: אֲהַלָּא Ch. Smegma, Sapo. Jobi 9.30. Talmudici per Cholem efferunt אוֹהֲלָא.

אַו, o Syr, ω, ô, Ho, vocandi seu exclamandi: Deinde ô aut, vel, sive. Item cùm duos comparativos connectit, ponitur pro ή, quàm.

אוּל Ch. Initium, Principium. Vox est Chaldaeis, Arabibus & Persis usitata: ut בְּרֵאשִׁית בְּרָא אֱלֹהִים In principio creavit Deus, trasfertur Ch.in Jonath, & T.Hier. בְּאוּלָא, Arab. אוּל חלק. Perf. דר אול.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Arabic-script words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; several vowel points and superscript marks are uncertain. The Syriac entries in lines 4, 5 and 10 are approximate.
